record.bible_text: Hear<WH08085><WTH8798>, O Israel<WH03478>: Thou <FI>art<Fi> to pass over<WH05674><WTH8802> Jordan<WH03383> this day<WH03117>, to go in<WH0935><WTH8800> to possess<WH03423><WTH8800> nations<WH01471> greater<WH01419> and mightier<WH06099> than thyself, cities<WH05892> great<WH01419> and fenced up<WH01219><WTH8803> to heaven<WH08064>,

Understand<WH03045><WTH8804> therefore, that the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430> giveth<WH05414><WTH8802> thee not this good<WH02896> land<WH0776> to possess<WH03423><WTH8800> it for thy righteousness<WH06666>; for thou <FI>art<Fi> a stiffnecked<WH06203><WH07186> people<WH05971>.<CM>

Also in Horeb<WH02722> ye provoked<WH07107><WH00> the LORD<WH03068> to wrath<WH07107><WTH8689>, so that the LORD<WH03068> was angry<WH0599><WTH8691> with you to have destroyed<WH08045><WTH8687> you.

And I took<WH08610><WTH8799> the two<WH08147> tables<WH03871>, and cast<WH07993><WTH8686> them out of<WH05921> my two<WH08147> hands<WH03027>, and brake<WH07665><WTH8762> them before your eyes<WH05869>.

And I fell down<WH05307><WTH8691> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068>, as at the first<WH07223>, forty<WH0705> days<WH03117> and forty<WH0705> nights<WH03915>: I did neither eat<WH0398><WTH8804> bread<WH03899>, nor drink<WH08354><WTH8804> water<WH04325>, because of all your sins<WH02403> which ye sinned<WH02398><WTH8804>, in doing<WH06213><WTH8800> wickedly<WH07451> in the sight<WH05869> of the LORD<WH03068>, to provoke him to anger<WH03707><WTH8687>.

And I took<WH03947><WTH8804> your sin<WH02403>, the calf<WH05695> which ye had made<WH06213><WTH8804>, and burnt<WH08313><WTH8799> it with fire<WH0784>, and stamped<WH03807><WTH8799> it, <FI>and<Fi> ground<WH02912><WTH8800> <FI>it<Fi> very small<WH03190><WTH8687>, <FI>even<Fi> until it was as small<WH01854><WTH8804> as dust<WH06083>: and I cast<WH07993><WTH8686> the dust<WH06083> thereof into the brook<WH05158> that descended out<WH03381><WTH8802> of the mount<WH02022>.
And at Taberah<WH08404>, and at Massah<WH04532>, and at Kibrothhattaavah<WH06914>, ye provoked the LORD<WH03068> to wrath<WH07107><WTH8688>.

Likewise when the LORD<WH03068> sent<WH07971><WTH8800> you from Kadeshbarnea<WH06947>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Go up<WH05927><WTH8798> and possess<WH03423><WTH8798> the land<WH0776> which I have given<WH05414><WTH8804> you; then ye rebelled<WH04784><WTH8686> against the commandment<WH06310> of the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>, and ye believed<WH0539><WTH8689> him not, nor hearkened<WH08085><WTH8804> to his voice<WH06963>.

I prayed<WH06419><WTH8691> therefore unto the LORD<WH03068>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, O Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, destroy<WH07843><WTH8686> not thy people<WH05971> and thine inheritance<WH05159>, which thou hast redeemed<WH06299><WTH8804> through thy greatness<WH01433>, which thou hast brought forth<WH03318><WTH8689> out of Egypt<WH04714> with a mighty<WH02389> hand<WH03027>.
